basic_details.job_title: ESIC Delhi Recruitment 2026 – Walkin for 50 Senior Resident, Specialist and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Senior Resident (Regular) under 3 Years Central Residency Scheme, Senior Resident Contractual for a period of (1)one year against GDMO, Full-Time Contractual Specialist and 1 more
basic_details.short_information: Employee's State Insurance Corporation (Ministry of Labour & Employment, Govt. of India) (ESIC), Delhi, has invited applications for 50 posts in 4 roles under Advt No. 115-A-12/16/ SR Rectt./2024-Med. - 1906. The posts include Senior Resident (Regular) under 3 Years Central Residency Scheme, Senior Resident Contractual for a period of (1)one year against GDMO, Full-Time Contractual Specialist, Part-Time Contractual Super Specialist. Selection is through a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Demand draft in favour of 'ESIC Fund Account No.1', payable at Delhi.

age_limit.age_details: Varies by post - see the table below

qualification.education_qualification: Senior Resident: PG Degree or Diploma in concerned speciality, registered with DMC/MCI (MBBS with 2 years' experience considered if PG candidates are not available). Specialist: MBBS with PG degree/diploma and 3/5 years' experience. Super Specialist: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB with DM/DNB/M.Ch and 3/5 years' experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in concerned speciality from recognized university; Registered with Delhi Medical Council or Medical Council of India; If PG/Diploma doctors are not available, MBBS doctors without PG with two years of experience (1 year in concerned speciality, government/private hospital, not a private clinic) may be appointed for 01 year on contract basis. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs. 67,700 (Basic Pay) as per level-11 of the 7th CPC matrix + other allowances per month as per rules applicable. how_to_apply: Appear for the walk-in interview on the date given for your department, reporting between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM.
Bring self-attested photocopies of certificates along with originals for document verification.
Bring two recent passport size photographs.
Candidates of other categories bring a demand draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of 'ESIC Fund Account No.1', payable at Delhi.
Candidates working in any Govt. Institution should apply through proper channel.
Attend on 25 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.
important_instructions: Vacancies may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent Medical Superintendent reserves the right to alter the date or cancel the interview No TA/DA for attending the walk-in interview Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Details
content_sections.text: Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in concerned speciality from recognized university; Registered with Delhi Medical Council or Medical Council of India; If PG/Diploma doctors are not available, MBBS doctors without PG with two years of experience (1 year in concerned speciality, government/private hospital, not a private clinic) may be appointed for 01 year on contract basis. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: Rs. 67,700 (Basic Pay) as per level-11 of the 7th CPC matrix + other allowances per month as per rules applicable. Qualification required: Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in concerned speciality from recognized university; Registered with Delhi Medical Council or Medical Council of India; MBBS with at least 2 years' working experience after MBBS (one year in concerned speciality) may appear and shall be selected if no PG/Diploma candidate appears in the identical speciality. Age limit: Maximum 45 years. Pay: As per ESIC Headquarters' office Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt.file) dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-Med.-VI dated 08.12.2022 (as per ESIC rules). Qualification required: MBBS with Post Graduate degree/diploma in concerned specialty from a recognized University with 3 years' experience after PG Degree or 5 years' experience after PG Diploma and registered with DMC/MCI. Experience required: 3 years after PG Degree or 5 years after PG Diploma. Age limit: Maximum 69 years. Pay: As per ESIC Headquarters' Office Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt. File) dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022 (As per ESIC rules). Qualification required: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB with DM/DNB/M.Ch in concerned Super Speciality from MCI recognized Medical College and registered with Delhi Medical Council or Medical Council; 3 or 5 years' experience by level. Experience required: Entry Level: 3 years in concerned super-speciality after first PG degree or 5 years after PG diploma; Senior Level: 5 years after first PG degree. Age limit: Maximum 69 years. Pay: Fixed Remuneration (16 hrs/week): Rs. 1,00,000 (Entry Level), Rs. 1,50,000 (Sr. Level).

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Pay for Non-PG SR, Senior Resident (GDMO) and Full-Time Contractual Specialist is as per ESIC Headquarters' Office Memoranda No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt. File) dated 13.04.2022 and Z-11012/51/2022-Med.-VI dated 08.12.2022. Senior Resident (3 Years CRS): initial 1 year, extendable to maximum 3 years, renewed yearly on satisfactory performance Senior Resident (GDMO), Specialist and Super Specialist: 1 year or till regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier Security deposit of Rs. 30,000/- at joining, refundable after tenure (minimum six months' service including 30 days' notice) and No Dues Certificate Agreement on Rs. 100/- non-judicial stamp paper at joining, cost borne by candidate Specialists must have professional Indemnity Bond of at least Rs. 20,00,000/- at joining

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Demand draft in favour of 'ESIC Fund Account No.1', payable at Delhi.

content_sections.heading: How Will ESIC Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Document verification Senior Resident (GDMO): MBBS candidates shall be selected only if no PG/Diploma candidate appears in the identical speciality Original certificates checked at document verification

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Identity Proof (Passport/Driving License/Voter Card/Aadhar Card etc.) Address Proof and Certificate showing Date of Birth (10th Certificate/Birth Certificate) Class 10th & 12th Mark Sheets or Certificates MBBS & MD/MS/DNB/DM and Experience Certificate as applicable Registration with Delhi Medical Council/Medical Council of India Reservation Category Certificate (OBC/SC/ST/PH/EWS) and two recent passport size photographs

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Appear for the walk-in interview on the date given for your department, reporting between 09:00 AM and 11:00 AM. Bring self-attested photocopies of certificates along with originals for document verification. Bring two recent passport size photographs. Candidates of other categories bring a demand draft of Rs. 500/- in favour of 'ESIC Fund Account No.1', payable at Delhi. Candidates working in any Govt. Institution should apply through proper channel. Attend on 25 November 2026, reporting at 9:00 AM.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Vacancies may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Medical Superintendent Medical Superintendent reserves the right to alter the date or cancel the interview No TA/DA for attending the walk-in interview Hostel accommodation/quarters will not be provided

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25 November 2026, and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 50 vacancies: 29 Senior Resident (Regular) under 3 Years Central Residency Scheme, 3 Senior Resident Contractual for a period of (1)one year against GDMO, 11 Full-Time Contractual Specialist, 7 Part-Time Contractual Super Specialist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ESIC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: SC/ST/Female Candidates/Ex-Servicemen & PH Candidates: Nil. All Other Categories: Rs. 500.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Senior Resident (Regular) under 3 Years Central Residency Scheme: maximum 45 years; Senior Resident Contractual for a period of (1)one year against GDMO: maximum 45 years; Full-Time Contractual Specialist: maximum 69 years; Part-Time Contractual Super Specialist: maximum 69 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 67,700 (Basic Pay) as per level-11 of the 7th CPC matrix + other allowances per month as per rules applicable for Senior Resident (Regular) under 3 Years Central Residency Scheme, As per ESIC Headquarters' office Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt.file) dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-Med.-VI dated 08.12.2022 (as per ESIC rules) for Senior Resident Contractual for a period of (1)one year against GDMO, As per ESIC Headquarters' Office Memorandum No. Z-17/11/1/2007/Med.IV (Pt. File) dated 13.04.2022 & Z-11012/51/2022-MED-VI dated 08.12.2022 (As per ESIC rules) for Full-Time Contractual Specialist, Fixed Remuneration (16 hrs/week): Rs. 1,00,000 (Entry Level), Rs. 1,50,000 (Sr. Level) for Part-Time Contractual Super Specialist.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Senior Resident: PG Degree or Diploma in concerned speciality, registered with DMC/MCI (MBBS with 2 years' experience considered if PG candidates are not available). Specialist: MBBS with PG degree/diploma and 3/5 years' experience. Super Specialist: MBBS, MD/MS/DNB with DM/DNB/M.Ch and 3/5 years' experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) certificate in prescribed Government of India format. Candidates working in any Govt. Institution should apply through proper channel.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates who have already worked as Senior Resident under Central Residency Scheme for 3 years cannot apply for Senior Resident.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Document verification. Senior Resident (GDMO): MBBS candidates shall be selected only if no PG/Diploma candidate appears in the identical speciality. Original certificates checked at document verification.
